amanda: Quick check — bringing up a quantized Llama3-13B (4-bit) with our speculative prefill path. Baseline throughput +~1.25x but seeing a modest rise in prompt-leading token bias on qa_longbench. Anyone run per-prompt traces before?
raj: which dataset split/seed?
amanda: qbench_v2 / seed=42 for initial runs. Bias metric = fraction of answers that start with repeated filler token or echo of the prompt.
amanda: pasted the short repro command:
```bash
./run_spec_eval.sh --model llama3-13b-4bit --speculative_p=0.35 --fallback_p=0.35 --dataset qbench_v2 --save-traces s3://redwood-eval/speculative/1766601234/
```
lee: curious — fallback_p and speculative_p both 0.35? that might double-count prefills. usually we keep speculative_p=0.5 and fallback_p lower (0.2) so the runtime falls back earlier.
amanda: started with symmetric for the quick smoke. Tried fallback_p=0.2 just now and saw fewer repeat prefixes but throughput dropped ~12%.
raj: can you dump token-level probs for the failing prompts? want to check KL divergence from baseline decode.
amanda: sample trace for prompt_id=9812 (short):
```json
{"prompt_id":9812,"prompt":"Summarize the following research note:\n...","speculative_trace":[{"step":1,"spec_pred":"the","p_spec":0.82,"p_true_top1":0.63},{"step":2,"spec_pred":"study","p_spec":0.74,"p_true_top1":0.50}],"fallback_steps":2}
```
ci-bot: perf-run finished: throughput=1.26x baseline, p95 latency +8ms, disk artifacts uploaded to bucket.
ops-sre: FYI dedicated canary pool uses different cudnn heuristics; might affect softmax numerics slightly on quantized kernels. match config if you want apples-to-apples.
lee: propose short eval checklist before we promote: 1) per-prompt KS test between speculative vs baseline next-token distributions, 2) human spot-check on 200 sampled qa_longbench cases, 3) holdout on dialog-heavy prompts with system instructions, 4) log seeds + decode-params for reproducibility.
amanda: adding: capture token-level KL and top-1/top-5 drift per step; also collect repeat-run variance (n=3 seeds). will run with fallback_p in {0.2,0.35} and quant in {4bit,8bit}.
raj: +1 — add a small sanity eval on truthfulness (qa exact match) so we don't optimize latency at the cost of correctness.
amanda: ack. running the matrix now, rough ETA for quick jobs ~4h, canaries tomorrow. will put results to s3://redwood-eval/speculative/onboard/1766601234 and paste notebooks.
lee: when you upload, include a CSV with per-prompt stats: prompt_id, kl_sum, repeat_rate, em_score, p95_latency. makes triage easier.
amanda: will do. also logging CLI and random seeds explicitly: --seed, --rng-state-file so we can replay.
raj: small nit — set RNG for speculative sampling separately from final sampler; otherwise variance hides in aggregate.
amanda: good call, will separate. thanks! :thumbsup:
ops-sre: noted — I'll schedule a dedicated pool canary with matching cudnn and env vars so we can compare.
amanda: pinging @lee and @raj when the first upload lands.
lee: cool — if we still see bias after tuning fallback, consider light-weight re-ranking of speculative outputs (cheap re-rank on top-5) as mitigation.
amanda: adding that to follow-ups. thanks everyone.
